name: @kasarlabs/ekubo-mcp

tools.name: get_pool_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive information about an Ekubo pool including current price, liquidity, and fee data.

token0_symbol.description: The symbol of the first token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token0_address.description: The contract address of the first token. Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided.

token1_symbol.description: The symbol of the second token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token1_address.description: The contract address of the second token. Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided.

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: get_token_price
tools.description: Get the price of a token via Ekubo pools by querying the pool price directly from the Core contract.

token_symbol.description: The symbol of the token to get the price for (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token_symbol or token_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token_address.description: The contract address of the token to get the price for. Either token_symbol or token_address must be provided.

quote_currency_symbol.description: The symbol of the quote currency (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either quote_currency_symbol or quote_currency_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

quote_currency_address.description: The contract address of the quote currency. Either quote_currency_symbol or quote_currency_address must be provided.

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: get_pool_liquidity
tools.description: Get the total liquidity available in an Ekubo pool at the current tick.

token0_symbol.description: The symbol of the first token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token0_address.description: The contract address of the first token. Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided.

token1_symbol.description: The symbol of the second token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token1_address.description: The contract address of the second token. Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided.

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: get_pool_fees_per_liquidity
tools.description: Get the cumulative fees per unit of liquidity for an Ekubo pool (both token0 and token1).

token0_symbol.description: The symbol of the first token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token0_address.description: The contract address of the first token. Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided.

token1_symbol.description: The symbol of the second token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token1_address.description: The contract address of the second token. Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided.

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: get_positions
tools.description: Get liquidity information for Ekubo positions. Can fetch all positions for an owner, or a specific position by ID. Returns the liquidity amount and fees per liquidity for the position(s).

owner_address.description: The owner address to fetch positions for

position_id.description: The NFT position ID (u64) to get liquidity information for

pageSize.description: The number of items per page (default: 50, max: 100)

state.description: The state of the position to filter by: "opened" for active positions, "closed" for closed positions (defaults to "opened")

tools.name: swap
tools.description: Swap tokens on Ekubo DEX. Supports both exact input (specify input amount) and exact output (specify desired output amount) swaps with configurable slippage tolerance. You can use token symbols (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH") or contract addresses. Supported symbols: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others. Either token_in_symbol or token_in_address must be provided, and either token_out_symbol or token_out_address must be provided.

token_in_symbol.description: The symbol of the token to sell (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token_in_symbol or token_in_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token_in_address.description: The contract address of the token to sell. Either token_in_symbol or token_in_address must be provided.

token_out_symbol.description: The symbol of the token to buy (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token_out_symbol or token_out_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token_out_address.description: The contract address of the token to buy. Either token_out_symbol or token_out_address must be provided.

amount.description: The amount to swap (in human decimals, e.g., "1" for 1 USDC)

is_amount_in.description: If true, amount is input token amount. If false, amount is desired output token amount

slippage_tolerance.description: Maximum slippage tolerance as a percentage (e.g., 0.5 for 0.5%, defaults to 0.5%)

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: create_position
tools.description: Create a new liquidity position (NFT) in an Ekubo pool within a specified price range (concentrated liquidity). Mints a new NFT position.

amount0.description: The amount of token0 to add (in human decimals, e.g., "1" for 1 USDC)

amount1.description: The amount of token1 to add (in human decimals, e.g., "1" for 1 USDC)

token0_symbol.description: The symbol of the first token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token0_address.description: The contract address of the first token. Either token0_symbol or token0_address must be provided.

token1_symbol.description: The symbol of the second token (e.g., "STRK", "USDC", "ETH", "WBTC"). Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided. Supported symbols include: STRK, USDC, USDT, ETH, DAI, WBTC, and many others.

token1_address.description: The contract address of the second token. Either token1_symbol or token1_address must be provided.

lower_price.description: The minimum price (token1/token0) for the position range. This will be converted to lower_tick automatically.

upper_price.description: The maximum price (token1/token0) for the position range. This will be converted to upper_tick automatically.

fee.description: The fee tier as a percentage (e.g., 0.05 for 0.05%, 0.3 for 0.3%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.05)

tick_spacing.description: The tick spacing as a percentage (e.g., 0.01 for 0.01%, 0.1 for 0.1%, 1 for 1%, defaults to 0.1)

tools.name: add_liquidity
tools.description: Add liquidity to an existing Ekubo pool position without minting a new NFT. Deposits tokens into the last position.

position_id.description: The NFT position ID (u64) to add liquidity to

amount0.description: The amount of token0 to add (in human decimals, e.g., "1" for 1 USDC)

amount1.description: The amount of token1 to add (in human decimals, e.g., "1" for 1 USDC)

state.description: The state of the position to filter by: "opened" for active positions, "closed" for closed positions (defaults to "opened")

tools.name: withdraw_liquidity
tools.description: Withdraw liquidity from an Ekubo pool position. Can withdraw full position, partial position, or only collect fees.

liquidity_amount.description: The amount of liquidity to remove (as a string to handle large numbers, set to "0" for fees only)

fees_only.description: Set to true to only collect fees without withdrawing liquidity (defaults to false)

collect_fees.description: Whether to collect accumulated fees (defaults to true)

tools.name: transfer_position
tools.description: Transfer an Ekubo NFT position to another address. The position NFT represents ownership of the liquidity position.

position_id.description: The NFT position ID to transfer (u64)

to_address.description: The recipient address to transfer the position to
